edges.relationship: Iacovetta identifies Thompson’s Making of the English Working Class as the foremost inspiration for her thesis and first book’s treatment of class as lived experience.

Original Thompson book and 1992 monograph unread; her retrospective testimony, not a claim of formal supervision or wholesale agreement.

edges.relationship: Iacovetta names Hobsbawm among the British Marxist historians highly influential in the intellectual formation of her thesis and first book.

Existing group 958/1170 routes are not already a Parr→Iacovetta personal resource.
